notice: Fictional Aurelia Air help-centre answers. Each one records the clause version it was written from and the travel dates it applies to, so a policy change can find the answers it makes stale.

answers.question: Can I get a bereavement fare after I have travelled?
answers.answer_text: No. Bereavement fares must be requested before travel begins. Once any part of the journey has been flown, the bereavement fare cannot be applied and no refund of the fare difference is available.

answers.question: Can I get a bereavement fare after I have travelled?
answers.answer_text: Yes. You can request the bereavement fare retroactively within 90 days of the date your ticket was issued. Send the documentation described in our bereavement policy and we refund the fare difference to your original form of payment.

answers.question: How much is the first checked bag?
answers.answer_text: The first checked bag costs $40 each way on Economy fares.

answers.question: How much does it cost to change a Standard Economy ticket?
answers.answer_text: There is no change fee for Standard Economy tickets. If the new flight costs more, you pay the difference in fare.

answers.question: Can my pet travel in the cabin with me?
answers.answer_text: Yes. Small cats and dogs can travel in the cabin if the pet and its carrier together weigh no more than 8 kg. The pet fee is $100 each way.

answers.question: What do I get if my flight arrives 7 hours late?
answers.answer_text: If the delay was within Aurelia Air's control and you arrived 6 hours or more but less than 9 hours late, you are entitled to $250 in compensation.

answers.question: How long is a travel credit valid?
answers.answer_text: Travel credits are valid for 12 months from the date they are issued. You need to book before the credit expires, but your flight can be after the expiry date.
